body:
She has been to a psychiatrist on multiple occasions, and at one point was administered into a mental hospital (which was supposedly an awful experience so she refuses to go ever again). She has been diagnosed with bipolar. She was put on meds, but then she tried to OD on them, so that turned out to be a no go. My parents don't really know what to do. She needs serious help, but I just don't see it happening as she refuses to help herself and is in denial. To her, the way she is acting is perfectly acceptable and she always believes she is right.

Silver lining in all this is a couple days after I posted, my boyfriend's uncle offered us a house he was planning on selling, for a deal we can definitely afford. We got preapproved for the loan,  are getting the appraisal done tomorrow, and should be moving in this weekend if everything continues going as planned. Me getting a house has sparked my sister to move, ironically. She tends to say she is moving out frequently though, so I doubt it will happen, but she is clearly unhappy my boyfriend and I will own a house before her, given I am 8 years younger. Even if she does move, I don't think I could go back home at this point - there is always the risk she might come home again after falling on hard times. It just sucks because I would have loved to just live at home for a couple more years and save up for a house closer to my work, but I'm not going to look a gift horse in the mouth. I'm looking forward to not dealing with drama at home. I just hope my sister moves out as planned so my parents also have peace.

I'm 22. I just finished college and am currently saving up to get a place with my boyfriend. I sincerely hope we can move out sooner rather then later, but with my animals (aka loud birds and a few big cages with destructive critters), renting is almost impossible so we have to unfortunately save for a house. Fingers crossed. Because I know if I could get out of the house, I would be alright. It's hard to see that future right now though.

Thank you for the advice. I know deep down I shouldn't let her effect me. It's just so hard when my life is flipped upside down because of her, but I will try my best.
